title: Fire on the Mountain
lyrics_synced:
[00:33.74] Moved my family away from my Carolina home.
[00:38.08] Had dreams about the west and started to roam.
[00:42.99] Six long months on a dust covered trail.
[00:47.31] They say that heavens at the end,
[00:49.90] but so far it's been hell.
[00:51.92] Fire on the Mountain,
[00:53.93] Lightning in the air.
[00:56.53] Gold in them hills,
[00:57.99] and it's waiting for me there.
[01:09.52] We were diggin & sittin from five to five.
[01:13.84] Sellin' everything we found
[01:15.79] just to stay alive.
[01:18.74] Gold flowed free like whisky in the bars.
[01:23.06] Singin' was the big thing, Lord
[01:24.80] and Sid was the star.
[01:27.69] Fire on the Mountain,
[01:29.74] Lightning in the air.
[01:32.31] Gold in them hills,
[01:33.82] and it's waiting for me there.
[02:22.22] Dance Hall girls were the evening treat.
[02:26.52] Empty cartridge & blood lines
[02:28.23] the Good Earth of the street.
[02:31.45] Men were shot down for the sake of fun
[02:35.77] Or just to hear the noise
[02:37.35] of their forty-four guns.
[02:40.37] Fire on the Mountain,
[02:41.85] Lightning in the air.
[02:44.98] Gold in them hills,
[02:46.48] and it's waiting for me there.
[02:57.93] Now my widow, she weeps by my grave.
[03:02.28] Tears flow free for her man she couldn't save.
[03:06.90] Shot down in cold blood
[03:08.35] by a gun that carried vain.
[03:11.51] All for a useless & no good worthless claim.
[03:16.15] Fire on the Mountain,
[03:18.16] Lightning in the air.
[03:20.76] Gold in them hills,
[03:22.78] and it's waiting for me there.
[03:26.55] Fire on the Mountain,
[03:28.55] Lightning in the air.
[03:30.82] Gold in them hills,
[03:32.87] and it's waiting for me there.
